column1: # The writer table of the DirectiveReceipt model: a copy of the variables table, the writer table heads, the map and
# the parts of row S5 of the design memo of #3828 (section 7, round 10). tools/tla/writers-check.py reads it.
# Differences from the memo, each one on purpose:
#   role        is a VARIABLE that no action primes (the memo: "a constant"), so that one run can leave the role free.
#   record, directive, receipt   are definitions over the last entry of `history` (the memo allows it).
#   mark        is NOT in the memo: the leader-local mark of the rejected designs FACT "local" and "record" (known-bad
#               configs local_f3, record_f1). Rows S1 and S3 write it; under every other FACT it stays FALSE.
